flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that 'Venus's-flytraps' ends with the yellow flowers lines (F8) and wrongly describes the speaker of 'Farther' as a parent climbing with their ageing father (F9), both of which would penalise a student's text analysis in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: It ends with the child's mind expanding outward, focusing on yellow flowers going, 'Almost to Detroit, almost to the sea.'
a parent climbs a mountain with their ageing father

mark_affecting.video_says: constantly shifting dynamic between a parent and a growing child
mark_affecting.lesson_says: The son has grown; his father is ageing; the roles are beginning to reverse
